facts.fact: 素读开篇：她养伤、吃饭、把 Archie 送的裙子洗坏了扔进破布堆，然后等封赏——盼总督府下午茶请帖，私下更馋军官胸前那种亮勋章；结果什么也没等到
facts.anchor: Kiamling waited for the accolades. An invitation to Government House to have high tea with the governor would have sufficed, but she secretly coveted one of those shiny medals

facts.fact: 没人敲门、没请帖，连平日请她捉僵尸的活也断了；她一边擦祖先神龛、换供茶一边皱眉，静玲也没跑回来看她，还在给姐姐冷战
facts.anchor: Neither knocks nor invitations appeared at her door. Not even the usual requests for her yiugwai-hunting services. She frowned as she cleaned out the ancestral shrine and refreshed the cups of tea.

facts.fact: 她擦铜钱剑：钱上不铸面值，而是一锤一锤敲上咒字——当年敲完她肩痛了好几天，祖母还在旁边刻薄
facts.anchor: Rather than being inscribed with characters denoting their worth, each coin had been individually struck with a hammer to stamp words of power on their surface.

facts.fact: Hoi（她叫 Hoi gor）举着拳头正要敲门，被她比作门口的石狮子；他回嘴：站的时间跟她没洗澡一样久，这味儿能挡僵尸，也能挡客人
facts.anchor: “About as long as it’s been since you last washed. An effective ward against geongsi, I suppose. Customers too.”

facts.fact: Hoi 说是来看她好不好：跑马地（Happy Valley）事件后有人被送进医院，官方定性是黄热病爆发
facts.anchor: “Believe it or not, I came to check if you were okay. People have been taken into hospital after the Happy Valley incident. A yellow-fever outbreak.”

facts.fact: 他挑明这是英国人的官方说法：黄热病加怪幻觉；蚊油价格飞涨，东印度公司的人把奎宁当茶灌
facts.anchor: “That’s the official story the British are telling. Yellow fever and strange hallucinations. The cost of mosquito oil has jumped, the East India Company men are guzzling quinine like it’s tea.

facts.fact: 官方版本：发生了踩踏、几匹马为公共安全被击毙、看台倒塌归咎于施工质量差——等于把锅扣在搭看台的 Leung 工头（Foreman Leung）头上
facts.anchor: “There was a stampede, and several horses had to be shot for public safety. The collapse of the grandstand is being blamed on poor workmanship.”

facts.fact: 她不肯听完，一次次空耗真气灌到脚上疾走，把两人距离拉到比他从海外回来之后任何时候都远
facts.anchor: Wasting burst after burst of qi, she pushed speed into her feet, putting more distance between them than there had been since he had returned from across an ocean.

facts.fact: 干果铺的宋先生（Mr Soon）上次火灾后还找她加过防护措施，可那笔钱至今没付——她这时才想起来
facts.anchor: Last time she’d seen him, he had been reconstructing, had even approached her for extra protections. Come to think of it, he had not yet paid for those…

facts.fact: 宋先生当街骂她：他本来生意兴隆有店铺，把全部家当押在一场“稳赢”的赌注上，她带着妖马一来，放贷人把一切收走，全怪她
facts.anchor: “I had everything. A thriving business, a shop! And then you came with demon horses after I had put it all on a sure bet. The moneylenders have taken everything. Because of you!”

facts.fact: 宋先生越骂越顺口，甩出最狠一句：是不是你因为嫉妒把祖母也杀了？还搬出“女人当捉鬼人阳气不够”的老话
facts.anchor: “Everyone is saying it,” the man hissed, getting into his stride now. “Did you murder your grandmother as well? We all know you were jealous of her.”

facts.fact: 她决定咽下那口倔强，为香港酒店（Hongkong Hotel）那件事向妹妹道歉，并打算连鬼节那夜的事也一并坦白
facts.anchor: It was time she swallowed that stubbornness of hers and apologised to her sister for what had happened at the Hongkong Hotel.

facts.fact: 圣约翰座堂门口：Archie 右臂吊着吊带，Reverend Nairns 又对他说了一句、往他手里塞了样东西就进堂，全程没看 Kiamling 一眼
facts.anchor: He turned to greet her, his right arm in a sling. Reverend Nairns said one more thing to him, dropping something into his hand before heading into the building

facts.fact: 他拳外垂着十字架、一串玫瑰念珠轻响，察觉她在看便塞进口袋；随后承认自己也撞了头，在踩踏中昏死过去——她最后的旁证也断了
facts.anchor: A set of rosary beads clinked gently, the cross dangling from his fist. He noticed her gaze and thrust his hand into his pocket. “I’m afraid I also hit my head.

facts.fact: 她当场纠正他：不叫 Kim，是 Kiamling（Kiam Ling），意思是“剑灵”，她生来就是斩鬼的
facts.anchor: “My name is not Kim, it’s Kiamling. Kiam Ling. It means Sword Spirit. I was forged to cut down the undead.

facts.fact: 躲雨的门廊被他命名为 lychgate（停灵门）：乡下人把死人抬几里路到教堂下葬，到了先在门下停灵，等牧师准备好
facts.anchor: “A lychgate. Back home in the country, people carried their dead miles upon miles to the nearest church for burial. When they got here, they would shelter under the lychgate until the priest was ready.

facts.fact: 回家见门半开，她低身拔剑破门，闯入者竟是茶楼里一起搅锅的 Wong Keilin，正把她的衣物往麻袋里塞
facts.anchor: “Wong Keilin?” The incredulity in Kiamling’s voice was clear. Her co-conspiring potwasher from the teahouse was the last person she’d expected to break into their hovel.

facts.fact: 她后知后觉地把旧事串起来：妹妹总来茶楼“hang”、两人一道去井边打水、把两份活都丢给她——那原来是调情
facts.anchor: Walking together to the well to draw water, leaving Kiamling doing two people’s jobs rather than one. That, she very belatedly realised, was flirting.

facts.fact: 她这才懂妹妹为何坚拒婚事、为何总说金兰花会（Golden Orchid Society），发誓有一天要一起逃走、过姐妹共居的日子——她原以为那只是图独立
facts.anchor: Jingling’s adamant refusal to consider marriage. How she had talked about the Golden Orchid Society, vowing that one day they would run away together and live in a sisterhood.

facts.fact: 章末落点：Au 家的宝贝小女儿，在娱乐区做工——在妓院（Keilin 说她一周去四五晚）
facts.anchor: Her precious little sister, the darling of the Au family, was working in the entertainment district. At a brothel.
